c74object.name: bbb.dmx.fixturemap
c74object.digest: Map fixture parameters into one or more DMX universes.
c74object.description: Loads a bbb.dmx patch JSON file, accepts fixture parameter messages, and outputs 512-channel DMX universe lists. It can output one selected universe or all known universes.

inlets.inlet: Patch loading and fixture parameter input.

outlets.outlet: DMX data. In single-universe mode this is a 512-value list. In all-universe mode this is universe id followed by 512 values.

method.name: read
method.description: Read a bbb.dmx patch JSON file immediately. Relative paths are resolved by Max against the patch/search path.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clear the current output frame to defaults.

method.name: reload
method.description: Reload the current patch JSON file.

method.name: reset
method.description: Reset loaded fixture channels to profile defaults.

method.name: bangall
method.description: Output all known universes as universe id followed by 512 DMX values.

method.name: set
method.description: Set an 8-bit, 16-bit, or 24-bit fixture parameter value. Use parameter pan_tilt with pan and tilt u16 values for paired movement.

method.name: nset
method.description: Set a normalized 0..1 fixture parameter value.

method.name: ptbytes
method.description: Patch movertrack pan/tilt byte output into a fixture using that fixture profile's byte order.

attribute.name: patch
attribute.description: Patch JSON path to read after object initialization and whenever the attribute changes. Attribute loading is deferred; use the read message for immediate explicit loading.

attribute.name: universe
attribute.description: Selected output universe for single-universe output.

attribute.name: universe_mode
attribute.description: Output mode: selected outputs a bare 512-value list; all outputs universe id plus 512 values.

attribute.name: autobang
attribute.description: When non-zero, output automatically after parameter changes.
